Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075162. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for standard type IC50, exact standard relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL values. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
